source: Mladen Miksa and Jakob Nordstrom, A Generalized Method for Proving Polynomial Calculus Degree Lower Bounds
checked_passages: Boolean truth convention and polynomial-calculus encoding
imported_conclusion: Functional graph-PHP CNF on an (s,delta)-boundary expander of maximum left degree d needs PC degree > delta*s/(2*d), over every field. No onto clauses or deficiency-one assumption.
local_encoding_transfer: Complement the paper truth convention. Derive each linear pigeon row equation from its CNF product and same-row exclusions through degree at most d. For B>=d, a linear-row PC refutation through B would yield a CNF PC refutation through B.
proof_boundary: Theorem 4.9 application proof read. Its general Corollary 3.29 dependency is imported; not independently re-proved or Lean-verified.
new_argument_checks: Sixteen original neighbors and eight retained neighbors

Conditioning on selected row pairs does not affect other row lists
Random boundary expansion proved by a direct union bound
PC consequence separation uses signed restrictions, not graph PC=NS
One weight selected for all high-rank source tuples
Original companion degrees retained after graph and row replacements
